# Token usage report — widgets

Generated <TS> from session(s) `s1` (1 config dirs, 2 subagents). API-reported usage, deduplicated by message id; local `<synthetic>` placeholders excluded.

**Columns:** *In* uncached input · *Cache w* cache writes · *Cache r* cache reads · *Out* output · *Billable* = In + Cache w + Out (cache reads cost a small fraction of input, so this is the better cost proxy) · *Total* = all four. Times are UTC.

## By label

| Label | Agents | Model(s) | Billable | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T001, T002 | 1 | claude-sonnet-5-5 | 0.3k | 1.3k |
| Survey the repo | 1 | claude-sonnet-5-5 | 0.1k | 1.1k |
| **All** | 2 | | **0.4k** | 2.4k |

## By agent

| Started | Who | Label | Task | Model | Calls | Billable | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-20 10:00 | subagent a1 | T001, T002 | T001, T002: 001-widget core | claude-sonnet-5-5 | 1 | 0.3k | 1.3k |
| 2026-10-20 10:00 | subagent a3 | Survey the repo | Survey the repo | claude-sonnet-5-5 | 1 | 0.1k | 1.1k |

## Notes

- A resumed subagent keeps its id, so its row covers every resume after a usage limit.
- Each coordinator row spans one session's main thread across account switches (several config dirs).
- Labels come from each card's own description (its leading task id or short code) — nothing is guessed from project-specific vocabulary.
